name: Icy Aria
body:
Requirement: Perform 3 ranks

Base effect: Allies within 30 feet gain resistance 3 against fire and cold damage. This resistance becomes 3 points higher at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter (maximum 15 at 20th level).

Refrain

You summon a localized blizzard, affecting a 20-feet long cone starting from your position. The creatures in this area suffer cold damage, which is halved on a successful Reflex save.

Weak Refrain: Creatures in the area suffer 1d4 points of damage per siren level (max 4d4).

Intermediate Refrain: Creatures in the area suffer 1d6 points of damage per siren level (max 8d6).

Strong refrain: Creatures in the area suffer 1d8 points of damage per siren level (max 12d8).
